During the [[New Republic Era]], a [[Color|light]]-skinned, blond [[human]] '''youngling''' dwelled on the [[planet]] [[At Achrann]], one of the isolated [[Jewels of the Old Republic]].<ref name="Can't Say" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> as the child—clad in a [[Clothing|jacket]] with a green hoodie underneath—sat with their legs crossed in a [[Troik]] camp beside a [[Unidentified human youngling 2|peer]], they were approached by the off-worlder [[Neel]].<ref name="Can't Say" /> The [[Gender|boy]]<ref name="This Could Be a Real Adventure">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> quickly recognized that the youngsters were hungry. Therefore, upon a brief hesitation,<ref name="Can't Say" /> he<ref name="Databank-Neel's hoverbike">{{Databank|neel-s-hoverbike|Neel's hoverbike}}</ref> offered them his [[Foodstuff|food]] ration, which the two youngsters accepted after exchanging surprised looks.<ref name="Can't Say" />
